title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Gas.cpp and Solver.cpp implement perfect-gas conservative finite-volume, stress/heat and time residual paths; recovered historical results now permit numerical assessment.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: GlobalMesh/Partition read CGNS, call METIS and build local owned/ghost mesh; workers drop full preprocessing mesh before iterations.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Solver.cpp computes spatial and total transient residuals; historical steady cases reduce only 0.388–1.713 orders, with persistent case-dependent force oscillations.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Gas.cpp provides Rusanov flux, accurately described in report; no demonstrated entropy-fixed Roe path.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Gas/Solver implements farfield, slip and no-slip walls; original surface output exists, though force split has a distinct normal-traction limitation.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Solver.cpp:1169–1176,1369–1378 blends reconstruction after startup; original outputs exist but exact historical executable binding is unproven.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Solver.cpp:269 onward computes Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback, including local first-order fallback; output diagnostics are unavailable.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Solver.cpp:676–704 adds full viscous traction to total force but tangent projection to split, so total can differ from pressure plus viscous components; result data absent. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady implicit path stops on mean-based plateau. Original Re20 and M0.15 inviscid force histories show significant oscillations despite approximately stationary half-window means.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Source counts strict misses separately but 14 steps exit below required minimum; reaching final time is labeled statistically_periodic despite no supported coherent shedding in the submitted history.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS, neighbor halos and reductions exist. Historical np2 packages and PDF pp.41–42 compare NACA M0.15 and Re20 with np8; exact historical binary attribution remains qualified.

disqualification_flags.evidence: Historical cf36ac0 Re200 metadata says statistically_periodic, while Solver.cpp:1741–1749 sets that status whenever final time is reached; t>150 Cl history is broadband (3.85% spectral power below 0.5, autocorrelation -0.0037 at reported 8.83-period), with no credible periodic shedding. Report discloses irregularity. Fourteen steps also stop below the required minimum five; 625 target misses are separately reported, not alleged fabricated. Historical binary binding remains unproven.
